citations.assessment: The received text names Mar Zutra and Rav Adda Sava as sons of Mari bar Issur who came before Rav Ashi. Heilprin proposes Acha in place of Adda. The unit does not name a third brother.
Acha Sava proposes another analogical case to Rav Ashi.
Acha Sava makes the distinction in the wording of the mishnah before Rav Ashi.
Acha Sava supplies a counterexample to Rav Ashi in the offering discussion.
Acha Sava addresses Rav Ashi in the final discussion of Hammanniach on liability for damage.
The end of this folio explicitly names Acha Sava telling Rav Ashi how to understand Rav Hamnuna’s difficulty.
The named target mentions a monument near the study-house entrance under Adda Sava. This is the reported burial tradition and its variant name.
Separately supports Mari’s father as Issur, and introduces Rava as a distinct actor in the dispute. This does not verify the quoted four-brother claim.
The internal Mari dossier reports Acha Sava and Mar Zutra as the sons. Kiddushin gives Adda and Mar Zutra. Neither passage names Rava as a third brother.
